official.publication: Blip-2: Bootstrapping language-image pre-training with frozen image encoders and large language models

summary.en: Efficient vision-language pretraining by bridging frozen image and language models
summary.zh: 通过连接冻结的图像模型与语言模型实现高效视觉语言预训练

displaySummary.zh: AI100（2022-2023）· 高效视觉语言连接

description.en:
BLIP-2 addresses the cost of vision-language pretraining by keeping both a pretrained image encoder and a large language model frozen. A lightweight Querying Transformer learns the interface between the two modalities through representation learning followed by generative vision-to-language learning.

This design reuses strong unimodal models instead of retraining an end-to-end stack, and the paper reports competitive zero-shot image-to-text generation and visual question answering with far fewer trainable parameters.
description.zh:
BLIP-2 通过冻结预训练图像编码器和大语言模型，降低视觉语言预训练的成本。一个轻量级 Querying Transformer 先学习跨模态表示，再学习从视觉到语言的生成接口。

这种设计复用强大的单模态模型，而不是重新训练完整端到端系统；论文报告它以更少的可训练参数，在零样本图文生成和视觉问答上取得有竞争力的结果。

text.en: BLIP-2 keeps the image encoder and large language model frozen and trains a lightweight Querying Transformer between them.
text.zh: BLIP-2 冻结图像编码器与大语言模型，只训练位于两者之间的轻量级 Querying Transformer。

text.en: Its training first aligns visual and language representations, then learns vision-to-language generation.
text.zh: 其训练先对齐视觉与语言表示，再学习从视觉到语言的生成。

html.en: Large vision-language systems were increasingly built by joining separately pretrained image and language models, but end-to-end pretraining remained computationally expensive. BLIP-2 reframed the problem as learning a compact bridge between already capable frozen components.
html.zh: 大型视觉语言系统越来越多地连接独立预训练的图像模型与语言模型，但端到端预训练仍然成本高昂。BLIP-2 将问题重构为：在已经强大的冻结组件之间学习一个紧凑接口。

html.en: A Querying Transformer extracts a small set of visual query representations from the frozen image encoder and passes them toward the frozen language model. Two pretraining stages separate representation alignment from generative learning, allowing the interface to learn without updating either large backbone.
html.zh: Querying Transformer 从冻结图像编码器中提取少量视觉查询表示，并把它们传向冻结语言模型。两个预训练阶段把表示对齐与生成学习分开，因此接口可以在不更新两侧大型主干的情况下完成学习。

html.en: Experts generally treat BLIP-2 as an influential demonstration that multimodal capability can be built by efficiently composing strong pretrained models. Its bridge-based recipe helped establish parameter-efficient visual instruction systems and foreshadowed later assistants that connect vision encoders to large language models.
html.zh: 专家通常把 BLIP-2 视为一项有影响力的证明：多模态能力可以通过高效组合强预训练模型获得。它的桥接方案推动了参数高效的视觉指令系统，并预示了后来把视觉编码器连接到大语言模型的助手。
